licenceNote: Third-party material: not covered by the project licences (NOTICE.md) until the parish records the author and permission.
limitations: Concept pictures, not shop drawings: carving depth, timber species, glass type, leading, frame, fixing and weathering are not specified.
The reliefs are drawn on a flat lunette with a bump map; their outline is stretched about 14 % vertically to the 2.25 m x 1.125 m semicircle (source ratio about 2.27:1).
The concept sheet shows ten doors in one elevation; the model has nine outside doors (3 front, 4 nave side, 2 service room); the mapping is the owner's choice of 8 November 2026.
No public-use/copyright clearance or final parish artwork approval is implied.
